credit.title: Milky Way central bar — original long-bar measurement schematic
credit.author: Universe Scales (original explanatory diagram)
credit.changes: New original SVG; rendered to 1200 × 800 JPEG and a 300 × 200 thumbnail. Wegg, Gerhard and Portail (2015) infer a 5.0 ± 0.2 kpc half-length for their two-component bar and an angle of 28–33 degrees to the Sun–center line. The diagram uses an approximately 10 kpc full length and 30-degree orientation. Random star glyphs, the bar width and the Sun's radial placement are illustrative, explicitly not measured catalog positions. No spiral-arm geometry is asserted.

credit.title: Boötes Void — original conceptual underdensity illustration
credit.author: Universe Scales (original explanatory diagram)
credit.changes: New original SVG diagram from cited scientific facts; rasterized to 1200 × 800 JPEG and 300 px-wide thumbnail. Source caption describes an underdense region and foreground galaxies. The source map itself is BY-SA and was NOT copied. This is an original explanatory sketch with explicitly illustrative dots; no measured density field, member catalog, size or boundary is implied.

credit.title: Baryon acoustic oscillation scale — original galaxy-pair separation diagram
credit.author: Universe Scales (original explanatory diagram)
credit.changes: New original SVG; rendered to 1200 × 800 JPEG and a 300 × 200 thumbnail. DESI describes BAO as a slight excess of tracer pairs separated by about 150 Mpc, inherited from early-plasma sound waves. The diagram labels one present-day comoving pair separation, not a bubble diameter. The galaxy glyphs are illustrative, not a catalog or a measured pair. No numerical correlation-function data are invented or plotted.
